summary: Remote WebSocket-driven PTY shell and remote-triggered self-upgrade on installer host
details: The package's main entrypoint auto-connects a WebSocket client to a configurable server (default ws://localhost:3456, overridable via SERVER_URL) and dispatches inbound messages to handlers that write bytes directly into a spawned local shell PTY (message-router.js -> handleTerminalInput -> term.pty.write in terminal.js), perform arbitrary file read/write, git operations, and file transfer on the installer's host. A remote party controlling the configured WS server therefore obtains full-host command execution. A separate `upgrade_agent` WS command triggers handleUpgradeAgent, which runs `npm view @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest version` and executes `npm install @yeaft/webchat-agent` via a spawned bash/VBScript wrapper, then restarts the managed systemd/launchd/PM2 service — allowing the remote server to arbitrarily replace the agent code the installer's service manager re-executes. At startup the agent additionally git-clones https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git into ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev, tracks the mutable branch via `git pull --ff-only`, chmods files under hooks/ to 0755, and registers the plugin as enabled in ~/.claude/settings.json, so whatever HEAD of that repo points to executes inside the Claude CLI plugin runtime on each start.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
